_comment: Guardrail corpus for JARVIS's matcher. Every entry here is a REAL case that
was hand-found during live testing across many sessions - several of them
were genuine bugs that shipped. Run scripts/run_guardrails.py before and
after touching anything in system/apps.py, system/drives.py, system/
tier: 'high' = act immediately | 'plausible' = ask 'did you mean X?' |
against the resolved path when a tier is high/plausible.
Entries marked machine_specific depend on this particular PC's files; they
are skipped automatically when the file is gone (see the runner).

resolve_tier.why: REGRESSION: 'browser' is an app-intent word, not part of the name
REGRESSION: index camelCase-splits to 'whats app'; word boundaries are not mishearings
D: drive folder - non-system drives are indexed
exact-alias short circuit beats extractOne tie-break
must not match a file merely named 'untitled'
must be the .mp4, NOT SDN_ARP_screenshots.zip - broke while cov saturated scores at 100
REAL STT slip - 2 of 3 words verbatim corroborates it; MUST NOT be demoted
garbled: 0 words verbatim -> must ASK, not act
no resume exists; used to open Spyder settings at HIGH confidence
must not latch onto a file called '1'

destructive_strict.why: exact name may resolve for delete/move
uncorroborated must NEVER become a destructive target

fast_path_no_shadow.why: REAL BUG: normalize() makes this 'what s my next class', the pattern missed, and FIXED fuzzy-matched 'next' — i.e. asking about class SKIPPED THE MUSIC TRACK
normalize() STRIPS trailing 'now' -> 'am i free right'
REAL BUG from live use: fuzzy-matched the 1-word media key 'next' and answered 'Skipping.' — it skipped the music track

fast_path_no_shadow.why: REAL BUG: went to the LLM, which said 'my knowledge does not extend to current class schedules'

what do i have on wednesday

fast_path_no_shadow.why: must work WITHOUT naming a browser; otherwise it fell through to the open-a-FILE path
a FOLDER called pes must still resolve as a file, not the website
REAL BUG: 'maps' is indexed as Microsoft.WindowsMaps, so this launched the NATIVE APP instead of Google Maps in the browser
fell through to _search_web and answered 'Searching for maps.'

fast_path_no_shadow.why: REAL BUG: leading 'open' sent it to the file opener -> 'Couldn't find that, sir.'
explicitly asking for the APP must still get the app
the maps rule must not swallow ordinary file opens

timetable_phrasing.why: before class: name it AND count down
mid-class: say what's next AND how long this one has left. 'another an hour' was a real grammar bug
in a gap: countdown, no 'you're in'
day is done: no countdown across ~16 hours

clipboard_attach.say: can you explain the part which is copied in clipboard
clipboard_attach.why: REAL MISS: the most explicit phrasing had no demonstrative, so it matched nothing
must NOT attach - the clipboard may hold a password
a general question is not about copied text
